verdict.rationale: The only published pricing covers API credits for developers: 1,000 free credits per month, then $0.007 per credit. Developers are also told they get 'a percentage of the sale price', but that percentage is not stated. Nothing in the evidence publishes the fees a merchant pays on agent-originated transactions, so a merchant cannot price agentic channels from these docs.

support.subject: As a merchant, the fees for agent-originated transactions are published — I can price agentic channels without asking sales
